summary: Admin Activate Subscription and Diagnose-Repair Features Testing Complete. 10/11 backend tests passed (1 skipped due to known bug). Frontend Activate Subscription button tested and working correctly.

minor.issue: When called with only org_id (no email), returns 500 error. Line 4107 in server.py calls user_doc.get('stripe_customer_id') but user_doc is None when no email is provided.
minor.fix: Add null check: customer_id = user_doc.get('stripe_customer_id') if user_doc else None

admin_activate_subscription.details: POST /api/admin/organizations/{org_id}/activate endpoint works correctly. Returns org_id, tier_id, status=active. Tested with demo org.

activate_button_ui.details: Admin Dashboard shows 'Activate Subscription' button on org cards with trial status. Button triggers confirmation dialog, calls API, shows success toast, and removes button after activation.

entitlement_after_activation.details: After admin activates subscription, entitlement endpoint returns is_entitled=true, is_trial=false

diagnose_repair_with_email_and_org_id.details: POST /api/admin/subscription/diagnose-repair works with both email and org_id parameters

diagnose_repair_with_org_id_only.details: Returns 500 error when only org_id is provided (no email). Bug in server.py line 4107.

checkout_session_metadata.details: Code review confirms checkout session creation (POST /api/payments/checkout) includes organization_id, user_id, and user_email in metadata (lines 5054-5056)

action_items: FIX: server.py line 4107 - Add null check for user_doc before calling .get(). Change: customer_id = user_doc.get('stripe_customer_id') if user_doc else None
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout session metadata fix verified: Lines 5001-5005 correctly extract user context, lines 5054-5056 include org_id/user_id/user_email in session metadata
Admin activate endpoint (lines 4316-4424) correctly creates/updates subscription, marks trials as superseded, and updates user record
Bug found: diagnose-repair endpoint (line 4107) doesn't handle case when user_doc is None (org_id only provided)

success_rate.backend: 91% (10/11 tests - 1 skipped due to known bug)

rca_of_the_issue.original_issue: Stripe checkout session metadata was missing organization_id and user_id, causing subscription records to be created without org links
rca_of_the_issue.fix_verified: Checkout session creation now includes organization_id, user_id, and user_email in metadata (server.py lines 5054-5056). User context is extracted at lines 5001-5005 using get_current_user(request).

new_bug_found.description: diagnose-repair endpoint crashes when called with only org_id (no email) because user_doc is None and code tries to call user_doc.get()
new_bug_found.fix: Add null check: customer_id = user_doc.get('stripe_customer_id') if user_doc else None
